Length of tangent and power of a point wrt a circle
tangents drawn from an external point to a circle

concept_use.Tangent and normal to a circle: Tangent and normal to a circle: the tangent at the nearest point Q is perpendicular to the radius OQ (so parallel to AB) and cuts off triangle PDE.
concept_use.Length of tangent and power of a point w: Length of tangent PA = sqrt(S(P)) = 4 (power of P) fixes the triangle PAB.
concept_use.tangents drawn from an external point to: Tangents drawn from the external point P(4,6) to C, their half-angle with sin = 3/5, and their meeting points D, E with the third tangent.
concept_use.Chord of contact for Circle: Chord of contact AB of P, perpendicular to OP, bounds the big triangle PAB (area 7.68).

english: Let $C$ be the circle $x^{2}+y^{2}-2x-4y-4=0$ and $P=(4,6)$. The tangents drawn from $P$ to $C$ touch $C$ at $A$ and $B$. The tangent to $C$ at the point of the minor arc $AB$ nearest to $P$ meets $PA$ and $PB$ at $D$ and $E$, respectively. Then the area of the quadrilateral $ABED$ is ______.
hindi: माना कि $C$ वृत्त $x^{2}+y^{2}-2x-4y-4=0$ है तथा $P=(4,6)$ है। $P$ से $C$ पर खींची गई स्पर्श रेखाएँ $C$ को $A$ तथा $B$ पर स्पर्श करती हैं। लघु चाप $AB$ के $P$ के निकटतम बिन्दु पर $C$ की स्पर्श रेखा $PA$ तथा $PB$ को क्रमशः $D$ तथा $E$ पर मिलती है। तब चतुर्भुज $ABED$ का क्षेत्रफल ______ है।
solution: Triangle $PAB$ (bounded by the chord of contact $AB$): area $=PA^{2}\sin\alpha\cos\alpha=16\cdot\dfrac{12}{25}=7.68$
Nearest point $Q$ of the arc is on $OP$ with $PQ=OP-r=2$; the tangent at $Q$ is perpendicular to $OP$ (parallel to $AB$): triangle $PDE$ area $=PQ^{2}\tan\alpha=4\cdot\dfrac{3}{4}=3$
solution_full: $AB$ is the chord of contact of $P$; it is perpendicular to $OP$. Its distance from $P$ is $PA\cos\alpha=\dfrac{16}{5}$ and its half-length is $PA\sin\alpha=\dfrac{12}{5}$, so area of triangle $PAB=\dfrac{16}{5}\cdot\dfrac{12}{5}=\dfrac{192}{25}=7.68$.
The point of the minor arc nearest to $P$ is $Q$, where $OP$ meets $C$: $PQ=OP-r=2$.
The tangent at $Q$ is perpendicular to $OQ$, i.e. to $OP$, so it is parallel to $AB$. It cuts $PA$, $PB$ at $D$, $E$ with $QD=QE=PQ\tan\alpha=2\cdot\dfrac{3}{4}=\dfrac{3}{2}$.
$ABED$ is the trapezium between the parallel lines $AB$ and $DE$: area $=7.68-3=4.68$.
originality_note: New: the trapezium cut from the tangent triangle of an external point by the tangent at the nearest point of the circle (way 5: chord of contact and a parallel tangent combined). Closest known: area of the triangle formed by the two tangents from a point and the chord of contact. Different because: a second, parallel tangent cuts a smaller similar triangle, and the region between them is asked.
stem_review: Read as a student: every point, curve and parameter is introduced, the conditions are complete, there is one reading, the answer is unique and equals the Answer Plan, and the Hindi mirrors the English. Checked that 'the point of the minor arc AB nearest to P' is unique (on OP) and that D, E lie between P and A, B. Answer 4.68 is a positive decimal as planned. No change.
key_step: Area of triangle PAB from the tangent length and half-angle, minus the similar triangle cut off by the parallel tangent at the nearest point.
justification: Four standard tangent facts linked in one figure with two areas; no options and exact decimal arithmetic. Average Advanced numerical, like 2021-P1-Q1 (L3).
